items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC7 met: one object under every alias incl. _shipwright_shared_lib (28 identity cases, fail on the old resolver: 18 red); recogniser follows the 14.1 algorithm with 27 shared fixture rows; known-location helpers; fallback scan (11 pairs + import-error literals); moved-layout basename test over all four consumers; handoff list via CONFIG_FILES, byte-identical.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: classify is total (random-bytes test, None/str input); render raises ValueError on non-SemVer input; _unify leaves None/fake/foreign-tree bare entries alone.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No path is ever read from the stub (public API pinned to classify/render/Verdict); stdlib only; render refuses newline injection.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Identity, fallback and moved-layout checks run in fresh interpreters (no sys.modules leakage); importlib mechanism pinned by a toy contract test; static rule proven by a synthetic positive case; run on 3.11/3.12/3.13.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: _unify is O(1) dict lookups at import; no new import in the resolver.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Resolver 294 lines (cap 300) after trimming duplicated API prose; recogniser is its own module; shared fixtures in shared/testkit.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Stub text producer/consumer round-trip tested; no existing serialized format changes. Found and recorded a pre-existing gap (check_file_size fallback dead) as strict xfail + BRIEF 12 item 8.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene over the five touched test files: no findings.
